conviction_note: No unpriced company-level number found. Gerresheimer is publishing preliminary Q3 (Jun-Aug) figures for a quarter that closed on Aug 31. Management held the FY2026 guide on Sep 30, a month after that close, and has filed no ad-hoc since, so a large Q3 miss is unlikely. Against that, the sell side already sits at the bottom of the margin guide and below the FCF guide, and the stock has run 15% in 20 days to above 13 of 15 analyst targets with no catalyst I could find. The findings net slightly negative (-0.9) and the scaled number is -0.24 (p_up 48 x abs 6.0). The two disagree only in size: the sum counts three small independent facts, while p_up sits near 50 because none of them decides the print.

Most likely reiterated, possibly narrowed to the low end of 17-18%. A formal cut is the main downside tail. The guide may also be restated for discontinued operations now that Centor has been deconsolidated (closed Oct 1). Direction unknown; this is the line that sets the size of the move
H1 FCF was -122m, so H2 needs +22 to +72m to land in the -50/-100 guide. Consensus is -101.7m, just outside it. A reiterated FCF guide would beat consensus; a cut is already partly in the estimates

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun-Aug) closed on Aug 31. On Sep 30, a month later, management still guided a 'stronger second half with improved earnings', and the guide stood per Börsen-Zeitung. No MAR ad-hoc has been filed since, so a material Q3 miss against the guide path is unlikely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Preliminary-results days moved +4.41% (2026-08-27, Q1) and +5.47% (2026-09-30, Q2, then -4.22% the next day). The guide cut on 2026-06-29 moved +5.93% (relief that the audited accounts were out).
findings.original_quote: Für das laufende Geschäftsjahr 2026 erwartet Gerresheimer ein stärkeres zweites Halbjahr mit Ergebnisverbesserung und eine deutlich verbesserte Finanzlage. (For FY2026 Gerresheimer expects a stronger second half with improved earnings and a significantly improved financial position.) / Börsen-Zeitung: 'Die Prognose für 2026 hat dennoch Bestand.' (The 2026 guidance nevertheless stands.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The statement is a month old and the stock rose 5.5% that day. What may not be priced is the timing: the statement came after Q3 had closed, which most previews do not point out. If the market had fully read it as a de-risked Q3, the Q3 consensus would not still sit on only 3 estimates with a 102.5-106.4m spread.
findings.independence: https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/gerresheimer-setzt-zur-aufholjagd-an (independent report that the guide stands; its quoted 18-19% margin is the pre-June guide and is wrong). Neither source quantifies Q3.

findings.finding: The company-published Vara consensus already sits at the bottom of the guide: FY adj. EBITDA 398.7m is a 17.17% margin against the 17-18% range, and FCF -101.7m is below the -50/-100 guide. H1 delivered only 168m of EBITDA and -122m of FCF, so the guide needs H2 EBITDA of about 223-255m (Q2 run rate 102m) and +22 to +72m of H2 FCF. Narrowing to the low end is a non-event; a formal cut, on margin or on cash, is the asymmetric risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two formal guide cuts: 2025-10-08 (Q3 2025 prelim with a cut), a double-digit fall per finanzen.net; 2026-06-29, +5.9%, but bundled with the audited accounts. FCF was the line of the Q2 release (-92m on reduced reverse factoring), and the stock gave back 4.2% the day after it.
findings.why_not_priced: The sell side has priced a low-end outcome, but the price has not followed it: the stock is 32.16 against a mean target of 27.57, with 2 Buys, 9 Holds and 4 Sells. A market that had priced a low-end or cut scenario would not sit 17% above the sell side's own valuation after a 15% run.
findings.independence: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/gerresheimer-ag-publication-of-the-2025-financial-statements-on-june-29-2026-annual-general-meeting-on-september-1-2026-adjustment-of-the-2026-guidance/101a221a-eebb-417d-9ff9-8114ee022ace_en (the guide itself); H1 figures from the 2026-09-30 release. Same arithmetic, different documents.

findings.finding: Into the print the stock has run +15.4% in 20 sessions (Oct 16 +6.1%, Oct 19 +7.5%, Oct 26 +5.3%) to a 52-week high and above 13 of the 15 targets on the company's coverage page (mean EUR 27.57). I could find no filing or news catalyst for the run, and disclosed shorts are covering (3.87% to 3.38%), so the short fuel is shrinking.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Sep 30 prelim the stock rose +5.47% and gave back -4.22% the next day. After the Mar 20 +21.8% it fell -12.7% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is partly priced by definition. The point is that the bar in the price is higher than the published consensus: a reiterate-at-low-end print that the sell side would call in line can still be sold. If the run had been driven by known news, an EQS item or press story would explain it, and none does.
